verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to override low-level engine settings such as mlock or mmap in Ollama. A community user says the opposite: Ollama hides llama.cpp server configs behind its own defaults and won't let you enable mlock. With no vendor claim to contradict, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
